products.title: Tactical Turtle by Neil Melanson
products.body:
Neil Melanson is back with BJJ Fanatics to show his entire system for staying safe and generating real grappling offense from the turtle position
  • Neil Melanson is one of the best grappling coaches in the world, with a rare mix of Brazilian jiu-jitsu, catch wrestling, MMA ground game, and other grappling disciplines.
  • Learn all of the inside secrets behind this key to Neil’s catch wrestling system - and how grapplers of all levels can use them for rapid improvement on the mats.
  • Use the turtle position to stay safe and make this potentially dangerous defense into a bulletproof strength with these simple adjustments.
  • See how wrestling reversals can get you back on top and into dominant position, including ankle picks, single legs, rolls, peek outs, and more
  • Lock up submissions that can finish the fight, including Neil’s devastating double wrist lock kimura series.


Weaponize The Turtle Position And Learn The Catch Wrestling & Submission Grappling Secrets Of Neil Melanson’s Tactical Turtle System - Including Powerful Submissions, Reversals, and More!

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

Turn your turtle position from a defensive shell into an offensive go-to with Neil Melanson’s 8-volume mega-series on how to use catch-wrestling and grappling concepts for the most dangerous possible system. 

Neil Melanson is one of the most prolific and respected grappling coaches in the world, with students excelling in MMA and grappling competition with his unique blend of technique. Neil’s long history of catch wrestling gives him a new world of attacks to draw from, and because of that his turtle system is one of the most effective in grappling.

Use catch wrestling-inspired offense like the double wrist lock kimura series that Neil uses from everywhere, and hunt for tight leg locks, chokes, arm locks, and more. Use Neil’s special details on each move to bring out the most leverage in every exchange, so you can control the fight even when your back is turned.

Reverse position with some of Neil’s most reliable moves, including peek outs, wrestling takedowns, and more. With front headlock and referee’s position concepts that can help you stay safe no matter where your opponent wants to take the fight, Neil shows you every detail for a tactical turtle that will level up your grappling counter offense.

products.title: Crack The Turtle by Neil Melanson
products.body:
Learn A Systematic Approach To Cracking The Turtle With World-Class Instructor Neil Melanson!
  • Melanson has coached MMA greats, BJJ phenoms, and everyone in between!
  • Build a complete system of attacking the turtle including front headlock submissions, go behinds, placing hooks, taking the back, and more!
  • Force opponents to play the dilemma of defending hooks/back takes, while simultaneously attacking with brutal rear naked chokes.
  • Dominate the turtle, and find clear-cut methods of staying on top.
  • Develop go-to attacks when you are in front of turtled opponents including the goose choke, gator choke, face lock, arm in guillotine, among other high-level techniques!
  • Use creative methods to attack the turtle position that most grapplers won’t see coming, including leg shelving, tilts, butt drags, and more!

products.title: The Modified Guillotine by Neil Melanson
products.body:
Overhaul Your Guillotine Setups, Finishes, and More With Neil Melanson’s 6-Part Series Dedicated To The Modified Guillotine!
  • Melanson is back with a complete guide on modifying the traditional guillotine into an even more effective tactic with TONS of unique guillotine variations.
  • Learn a wide range of guillotine style chokes including the high elbow guillotine, the handgun choke, the twisted fister, prayer chokes, and MORE!
  • Discover unique mechanics that transform any variation of guillotine choke into a high-percentage tool that can finish anyone!
  • With Neil’s no nonsense approach even older and less athletic practitioners will have the ability to finish a variety of strangles from a wide range of positions.
  • Develop a system of strangles that can be applied from top positions like the front head lock and top half guard as well as bottom positions like butterfly guard and bottom half!
  • Make guard passers fear applying pressure with Neil’s unique setups from low passing positions.
  • Master The Modified Guillotine with world-class coach and instructor Neil Melanson!

products.title: Defensive Tactics In The guard by Neil Melanson
products.body:
Take a savage approach to defending yourself inside the guard with one of the most dangerous men on the plane

  • Stop getting stuck in the teeth of the guard and work your way out with efficient brutal solutions that will unlock even the tightest guard game
  • Develop and increased sense of awareness and shutdown submission attempts just by simply correcting your own positioning
  • Take away angles and controls from the bottom player as you use Melanson’s blueprints to systematically dismantle the guard and get into good passing position
  • Defend collar ties, grapevines, wrist controls, overhooks, underhooks, and more, all with signature instruction from one of the most revered instructors on the planet

Defend Yourself in The Guard with The King of Technical Brutality and One of The World’s Most Sought After Instructors, Neil Melanson

 Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

A household name in the grappling world, Neil Melanson has been making brutal and effective contributions to the art for years. A highly sought after instructor, Melanson has been integral in the success of multiple academies as a high level coach and he’s been the choice of elite fighters like Vitor Belfort and Chael Sonnen. With a highly diverse and extensive background in martial arts, Melanson seamlessly blends the best of his knowledge to form the ultimate grappling hybrids. Often regarded as incredibly brutal and effective, Melanson’s technique stands alone and has been serving grapplers of all levels around the world for years! 

Tired of getting stuck in the guard? Check out these highly effective solutions from Melanson’s own personal toolbox. Cracking the code of a good guard and avoiding dangerous submission attempts can be one of the most frustrating scenarios in grappling. Melanson will show you how to rob bottom players of their ability to be effective, stripping them of critical control components, angles, and more, so you can finally free yourself from the clutches of even the most proficient guards! 


So, What’s In This Series!

Learn proper ways to position your body when in the guard, and the 3 critical directions of movement as you master better ways to navigate from the top position. Take away crucial angles from the bottom player, shed collar ties, beat the overhook and the underhook, free your wrists, untangle grapevines and more! This one of a kind  instructional series is dedicated to helping you unlock the most common frustrations of the guard, so you can stop spending precious time and energy and move on to passing! 

This specialized set of skills is an often overlooked piece of the puzzle. If you've been spending too much time on top, trying to break through, it’s time for a new approach. Melanson has the skills and techniques you need to quickly and efficiently dismantle the bottom players' plans of attack and get you on the road to passing. 

So, What Exactly Do You Get?

PART 1

  • BODY POSITION TOP
  • BODY POSITION ON THE BOTTOM
  • THREE DIRECTIONS OF MOVEMENT
  • BEATING THE COLLAR TIE

    • PART 2

  • BEATING THE UNDERHOOK

  • TAKING AWAY HARD ANGLES

    • PART 4

  • TAKING AWAY FOOT AND LEG CONTROL
  • BEATING GRAPEVINES
